description:
Affected extensions: custom-header.ex, custom-footer.ex
Upstream: ctx.ui.setHeader(factory) and ctx.ui.setFooter(factory) accept a factory function (tui, theme) => { render(width): string[], invalidate(): void, dispose?(): void }. This lets the component re-render on demand at any width and access the current theme.
Current workaround: set_header/set_footer accept plain map descriptors (e.g. %{type: :custom_header, title: 'octo_pi'}). The pi mascot TUI widget (custom-header.ts) and the live-rendered token/branch footer (custom-footer.ts) are not ported.
What's needed: UIContext.set_header and set_footer must accept either nil (restore default) or a render function (width :: integer -> [String.t()]) bound at component-mount time. The TUI render loop must call this function at the right render phase instead of applying a static descriptor.
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/custom-header.ts + custom-footer.ts
title: ctx.ui.set_header/set_footer render factory — accept (tui, theme) => component instead of plain map
